name: skillsforge
description: Work OS for productive Agent Skills in Codex - route skills, run workflows, keep a local library, and ship with least-privilege packaging.

interface.shortDescription: Productive Agent Skills Work OS for Codex - route, workflows, library, guarded package.
interface.longDescription: SkillsForge is a productivity Work OS for portable Agent Skills: packs, profiles, workflows, library recommendation, and operator terminals. Trust (validate, capability policy, guarded Codex packaging, evidence receipts) is the safety layer underneath. Hooks are host guardrails, not an OS sandbox.
defaultPrompt: Recommend the best SkillsForge skill and workflow for this task.
Update my local SkillsForge library and recommend skills for this session.
Package this skill as a guarded Codex plugin with least-privilege policy.
